senses.gloss: year (time it takes for any planet to orbit its star)
year (scheduled part of a calendar year spent in a specific activity)
year (group of people belonging to the same calendar year of typically educational events)
agreed upon length of time for work or employment
time set aside for performing a task

etymologies.text: Inherited from Old Polish rok. The plural forms are a result of suppletion with lato (“summer”).
